Marginal Citations
M5 1968 c. 67.
Miscellaneous offences and powers

18 Miscellaneous offences.

(1) It is an offence for a person to contravene any regulations made under this Act other
than regulations made in pursuance of section 10(2)(h) or (i).

(2) It is an offence for a person to contravene a condition or other term of a licence issued
under section 3 of this Act or of a licence or other authority issued under regulations
made under this Act, not being a licence issued under regulations made in pursuance
of section 10(2)(i).
